import ssl, socket, threading, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import requests
from requests import adapters
adapters._preloaded_ssl_context.load_verify_locations("ca.crt")  # test-only: trust scratch CA
seen = []
sctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
sctx.load_cert_chain("server.crt", "server.key")
sctx.load_verify_locations("ca.crt")
sctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_OPTIONAL
ls = socket.socket(); ls.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); ls.listen(5)
port = ls.getsockname()[1]
def serve():
    while True:
        c, _ = ls.accept()
        try:
            t = sctx.wrap_socket(c, server_side=True)
            pc = t.getpeercert()
            seen.append(dict(x[0] for x in pc["subject"])["commonName"] if pc else None)
            t.recv(4096)
            t.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
            t.close()
        except Exception as e:
            seen.append("ERR %r" % e)
threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True).start()
url = f"https://localhost:{port}/"
requests.get(url, verify=True, cert=("clientA.crt", "clientA.key"))
requests.get(url, verify=True)   # no client cert requested
print("server saw client cert CN per request:", seen)
EOF
